I am an undergraduate (Final Year) student in Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University and a Research Assistant at the Health Informatics Research Lab (HIRL) at DIU. My work spans deep learning, computer vision, diffusion models, and image synthesis and editing.

From October 2024 to September 2025, I completed the Japanese University Studies in Science & Technology (JUSST) academic exchange program at the University of Electro-Communications in Tokyo, Japan. At the Yanai Laboratory, I worked under Prof. Keiji Yanai on BengaliDiff, a diffusion model for few-shot Bengali font generation, and presented this research at ICDAR 2025 in Wuhan, China.
